'''Health and environment'''
*[[2026 United States cyclosporiasis outbreak]]
**[[Michigan Department of Health and Human Services|Michigan health officials]] lift an advisory against the consumption of [[lettuce]] in the [[Michigan|U.S. state]] after reporting a decline in cases of [[cyclosporiasis]], which is caused by ''[[Cyclospora cayetanensis]]''. [https://www.reuters.com/legal/litigation/cyclosporiasis-cases-michigan-climb-over-12400-health-officials-say-2026-08-06/ (Reuters)]
*[[Brazil]]'s [[National Institute for Space Research]] reports that [[Deforestation of the Amazon rainforest|deforestation]] of the [[Amazon rainforest]] fell to {{convert|2874|sqkm|ha}} from August 2025 to July 2026, a 37% annual decline and the lowest level since the institute's [[satellite monitoring]] began in 2016. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/deforestation-hits-record-low-in-brazilian-amazon (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[International sanctions during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[United States and the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**The [[United States Senate]] votes 86–11 to pass a bill imposing [[Sanctioning Russia Act|sanctions on Russia]]'s [[Energy in Russia|energy]] revenues, [[Banking in Russia|financial institutions]], [[Government of Russia|officials]], and [[Russian shadow fleet|shadow fleet]], while authorizing [[Tariffs in the second Trump administration|tariffs]] of up to 100% on major buyers of [[Russian oil]] and [[Natural gas in Russia|gas]]. The legislation will head to the [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. House of Representatives]] for a vote. [https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/sweeping-russia-energy-sanctions-head-toward-us-senate-passage-2026-08-07/ (Reuters)]
